v22_history_observability.key_residual: 189/768 design rows remained unresolved for exact activation history even after all four occupancy snapshots

scientific_question: Can source-provenance observations recover activation-history information that complete post-activation occupancy snapshots leave unresolved, and are occupancy and provenance evidence complementary?

latent_rows.reuse: the exact 384 v21/v22 three-source clustered/dispersed directed landscapes and the same three frozen activation histories

occupancy.value: complete non-source occupancy set at the frozen structural time

provenance.actions: one action P_node for every equilibrium-reachable non-source node
provenance.value: the exact equilibrium earliest-origin source set at that node under the activation history
provenance.interpretation: synthetic source-tag / provenance observation; not empirical ancestry

targets.full_activation_history: exact identity of H_anchor_first, H_second_first or H_third_first
targets.equilibrium_provenance_class: equivalence class of histories with the same complete equilibrium earliest-origin map

exact_design.pair_separation_formulation: for each target, every pair of histories with different target values must be separated by at least one selected action
exact_design.optimization: exact minimum-cardinality action set; ties broken lexicographically by action ID
exact_design.insufficient_library: minimum size null when the complete library cannot separate all target-discordant history pairs
exact_design.zero_measurement_identification: allowed when all histories share the same target value
exact_design.costs: unit combinatorial measurement count only; not field cost

static_origin_classes.unique_origin_node: node reachable from exactly one final source, ignoring activation time
static_origin_classes.confluence_node: node reachable from two or more final sources, ignoring activation time

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one v22 full-history-unresolved design row becomes exactly history-identifiable using provenance observations.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if provenance observations never rescue a v22 occupancy-unresolved history.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: There is at least one design row identifiable by occupancy-only but not provenance-only, and at least one identifiable by provenance-only but not occupancy-only.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if either direction of complementarity is absent.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: The combined occupancy+provenance library identifies exact activation history in strictly more design rows than either occupancy-only or provenance-only alone.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if combined identifiability does not strictly exceed both single evidence classes.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every design row and evidence library, minimum burden for equilibrium provenance class is <= minimum burden for full activation-history identity, treating insufficiency as infinity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: A provenance assay at a static unique-origin node never separates two activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row contains a static confluence node whose provenance tag separates at least one pair of activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no confluence provenance assay is history-informative.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row remains non-identifiable for exact activation history even after the complete occupancy and provenance libraries are combined.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the full combined library identifies history everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row requires fewer provenance/combined measurements for the equilibrium provenance target than for exact activation-history identity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if target compression never reduces burden.

secondary_outputs: identification rate by source geometry and evidence library
minimum burden distributions by target and evidence library
number of v22 unresolved rows rescued by provenance-only and by combined evidence
first-action family frequencies in exact minimum combined designs
fraction of informative provenance assays occurring at static confluence nodes
rows where complete provenance map is identical but transient occupancy distinguishes history
rows where occupancy signatures are identical but provenance differs
claim_boundary: A provenance tag is an idealized source-of-first-arrival observation, not genetic ancestry or admixture.
Equal unit action counts do not represent equal real sampling cost.
Exact history identity is limited to the three frozen activation schedules.
The experiment tests information complementarity under known truth, not empirical feasibility of source tagging.
stop_rules: Do not add new occupancy times after scoring.
Do not add a different provenance variable after scoring.
Do not include source nodes after scoring.
Do not alter the target definitions after scoring.
